explication: DeepFlow is a zero-code observability platform for cloud-native and AI applications. Host agents collect network, application, tracing, metric, and profiling signals; the server manages agents and metadata, ingests telemetry, and exposes query services. The agent workflow is represented through capture, flow/protocol processing, and forwarding; server management, ingestion, and querying remain distinct stages. README statements establish the product-level links; sampled source additionally confirms agent startup and server component startup. Unsampled subsystems are shown only where README capabilities and the repository tree support them.
